capabilities: Group CSS snippets and enable or disable them in one click or via command
Create one command per group to activate it from the command palette
Auto-switch snippet groups based on the active theme, color scheme, or platform name
Set platform-specific groups for mobile, tablet, and desktop
Enable or disable all snippets in a group from the settings tab
extras: A French version of the README is available. Snippet lists must be reloaded with the refresh button after removing snippets, though the plugin never activates nonexistent snippets.
intentEvidence: mimic the behavior of toggling snippet in the Snippet CSS from Appearance tab
problem: Obsidian's Appearance tab only lets you toggle CSS snippets one by one, with no grouping or automatic switching when themes or devices change.
summary: Snippet manager that groups CSS snippets for one-click toggling and auto-switches groups when the theme, color scheme, or platform changes.
